sec2.signOutOthers: Sign out of all other sessions

conn2.help: Providers linked for one-tap sign-in. You can sign in with any connected account.

reason.already_linked: That account is already connected to a different RemoteSEA account.
reason.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

notif2.help: Choose what lands in your inbox. Critical security emails are always sent.
notif2.title: Notifications.
notif2.appUpdatesDesc: When an employer moves one of your applications forward — shortlisted, interviewing, offered, or rejected.
notif2.messagesDesc: Direct messages and interview requests from verified hiring teams.
notif2.digestDesc: Top 5 matches for your saved filters, once a week.
notif2.instantDesc: Email the moment a role scores 90%+ against your profile.
notif2.newsDesc: Occasional updates when we ship something worth knowing about.
notif2.tipsDesc: Negotiation guides, async culture notes, salary data. Twice a month, max.
notif2.pushDesc: Real-time alerts on this device, even when RemoteSEA isn't open. Not built yet — this won't do anything until it is.

priv2.help: Control how visible you are and take your data with you whenever you want.
priv2.title: Privacy &
priv2.downloadDesc: Your profile, applications, and job alerts as a JSON export.
priv2.seo: Let search engines index my public profile
priv2.seoDesc: Off by default. When on, your public talent page can appear in Google results. Not built yet — this won't do anything until it is.

dz.help: Reversible and irreversible actions. Pausing is safe — deleting is not.
dz.pausedDesc: You can still sign in. Reactivate anytime — nothing was deleted.
dz.pauseDesc: Marks your account as paused. You can reactivate anytime — nothing is deleted.
dz.deleteDesc: Permanently remove your profile, applications, and message history. This cannot be undone.

del.message: Are you sure? This cannot be undone.
del.passwordHint: Leave blank if you sign in only with Google, GitHub or LinkedIn.
del.confirmHint: This permanently erases your account and data.

tfa.title: Two-factor authentication
tfa.desc: Require a code from your authenticator app at sign-in. Strongest protection against takeovers.
tfa.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy…), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
tfa.saveCodes: Save these backup codes somewhere safe — each works once if you lose access to your authenticator app. They won't be shown again.
tfa.disablePrompt: Enter your password to disable two-factor authentication.
